'''Module Reports''' are special papers obtained by scanning either the [[Modules#Phase_Module|Phase Module]], [[Modules#Vector_Module|Vector Module]], or the [[Modules#Dislodgement_Module|Dislodgement Module]] in the [[Relay Tower]]. They give specialized information depending on the [[Modules|Module]] scanned. They are distributed by PecTech™.

==''Phase Report''==
{{Item Info|title1=Phase Report|image1=Phase Report.png|type=Map|stackable=No|tooltip=Displays the current scanned evolution report.|id=srparasites:phase_report}}
The Phase Report is obtained by scanning the Phase Module. It displays the following:
*Dimension (-1 = Nether, 0 = Overworld, 1 = End)
*Current [[Evolution Phases|Evolution Phase]]
*Total points 
*Points required for the next Phase change
*Percent of progress towards the next Phase
*Phase cooldown (in seconds) when parasites can't gain points
*Parasite mob cap
*Current [[Generations|Generation]]
*Ticks required until next Generation level
*Current Parasite Count
*Number of disguised mobs with [[Call Of The Hive|CotH]]
*Whether point gain or loss is enabled

==''Vector Map''==
{{Item Info|title1=Vector Map|image1=Vector Map.png|type=Map|stackable=No|tooltip=Obtained and filled with data from scanning the Vector Module in the Relay.|id=srparasites:vector_map}}
The Vector Map is obtained by scanning the Vector Module. One is given for every scanned Vector in the dimension. It displays the following:
*XYZ coordinates of a certain [[Emerging Infestation Vector]]
*The size and health of that Vector
*A 5000x5000 block grid displaying Vectors, scan origin, and the X and Z coordinates








==''Dislodgement Report''==
{{Item Info|title1=Dislodgement Report|image1=Dislodgement Report.png|type=Map|stackable=No|tooltip=Obtained from scanning the Dislodgement Module in the array.|id=srparasites:dislodgement_report}}
The Dislodgement Report is obtained by scanning the Dislodgement Module. It displays the following information about the current state of the [[Dislodgment System|Dislodgement Code]]:
*Dimension (-1 = Nether, 0 = Overworld, 1 = End)
*Event (Code #)
*Duration the effect is active
**When this time reaches zero, the entry will be crossed out
*Effect of the displayed code event
*Value for the event
*Code "threat" level denoted by ⚠︎ symbols (one being the least threatening, three being the highest)<ref>
*Code o - ⚠︎
*Code 1 - ⚠︎⚠︎
*Code 2 - Unknown
*Code 3 - ⚠︎⚠︎⚠︎
*Code 4 - ⚠︎⚠︎
*Code 6 - ⚠︎
*Code 7 - ⚠︎
*Code 8 - ⚠︎⚠︎
*Code 9 - ⚠︎
*Code 10 - ⚠︎⚠︎
*Code 11 - ⚠︎⚠︎⚠︎
*Code 12 - ⚠︎⚠︎⚠︎
*Code 13 - ⚠︎⚠︎
*Code 14 - ⚠︎⚠︎⚠︎
*Code 15 - ⚠︎
*Code 16 - ⚠︎
*Code 17 - ⚠︎⚠︎
*Code 18 - ⚠︎⚠︎
*Code 19 - ⚠︎
*Code 20 - ⚠︎
*Code 21 - ⚠︎⚠︎⚠︎
*Code 22 - ⚠︎⚠︎
*Code 25 - ⚠︎⚠︎⚠︎</ref>
**Invalid codes are denoted by blue malformed squares
